summary: Empty sealed gardens bay beside the road, no homes anywhere near.

drivers.seclusion: Only a memorial wall 78 m away; gardens and bush surround it, no homes.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed bay with a disabled marking, opens straight off the access road; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Gardens road runs just north; visitor and bus traffic by day.
drivers.convention: No vans or tents seen; looks like a visitor drop-off bay, overnight acceptance unknown.

flags: Slope at the bay not measured; ground at the pin is 13% mean, steep hillside
Likely patrolled or closed at night as a gardens attraction
Mapped gate 286 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Mostly open sun; trees shade the west and north edges.

best_section.where: Sealed bay just north-east of the pin, below the road junction and beside the Freedom Wall path
